bio: Ogata, a temple dedicated to Japanese art de vivre, is located in a private mansion in the Marais and masterminded by Shinichiro Ogata, world-famous designer and connoisseur. The (mainly) traditional Japanese food sports an omakase spirit, through a tasting menu comprised of immaculate seasonal produce (first-class sashimi). The best seats are at the counter. Pop into the shop or art gallery on your way out…...
